notes.title: ✨ Fixing a lot of bugs and text, adding new sounds
notes.content:
🖐 Hey, everybody! 

🛠 All the fixes in this update:

 A lot of textual, grammatical, punctuation, logical errors
 Volume of sounds and music returned to original (take care of your ears when you first start!)
 A bug in recent builds where the train sound would not start at the beginning has been fixed


✨ Was added:

 Links to Twitter and crossover with our other game Experimentation, you can get to it right from the main menu
 New images, such as the newspaper from the train or the flower behind Sarah's ear
 Huge amount of new sounds such as knife stabs, ocean sounds, bird sounds, explosions and fire, Jessie's moans


🎯 Work on the game will continue! We are trying to make the most interesting product for you. Thanks to everyone who supports, leaves comments and reviews of the game!

🎄 Happy Holidays everyone!

notes.title: Update 1.251
notes.content:
Fixed:


 Day instead of night outside the window after basketball day after the incident with Sarah
 At Leon's "bad" ending, mentioning that the hero was already in that room


Have a good day everyone!

notes.title: Update 1.25
notes.content:
Fixed: 


 Mention of the shocker in the endings with the teacher, where it was taken, but not used
 Playing with "meat" at practice before a basketball game
 If you stayed in the crowd during disco and then went with Sarah, she became Samantha in one reply


Thanks for pointing out the bugs! Soundtrack + artbook for the game with sketches, original versions of some backgrounds and artwork will be released soon.

notes.title: Update 1.24
notes.content:
Fixed:.


 A remark by the protagonist that he was already visiting Samantha in one of the endings, when he wasn't there;
 Crashing out to the main menu under certain circumstances at the camping if you go by Leon's root and get Grant and the teacher dead beforehand.


Have a good day everyone!

notes.title: Update 1.22
notes.content:
Fixed:


 The achievement granting system will now grant achievements even if you have somehow already gotten them previously within the game (bug or version of the game from other stores);
 Added a police officer sprite after Leon's party in cases where Elisabeth doesn't make it to that point;
 Character sprites now don't cling to the killer after the same party at Leon's place.


Have a good day and cheer everyone!

Sincerely,
Faithy
